faqs.q: What are the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps used for?
faqs.a: Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps are band clamps tightened by a T-bolt that close down on a hose over a stated diameter range. This listing carries 15 models with part numbers HC095 to HC300 and beyond.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps?
faqs.a: The listing carries 15 models, with part numbers such as HC095, HC100 and HC300, named by their nominal diameter, for example the 1" and 1-1/2" T-bolt clamps. Each clamp is sized by the diameter range it closes down on.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps?
faqs.a: Measure the outside diameter of the hose on its fitting and pick the clamp whose range spans it, using the part number from the size table. A clamp used at the end of its range holds less well, so choose one with the hose diameter near the middle.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the Buyers Products T-bolt clamps, and a clamp's holding power depends on the hose, the shank and the torque. Give us the hose, the fitting and the pressure through [our contact page](/contact) and we check it before you order.

faqs.q: What are the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the clamp material, so we confirm band and bolt material when you enquire. Tell us whether the clamp will see wet, salt or chemical service and we check it against the maker's data.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, SAE or EN standard for the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps and holds no certificates. If your project needs a material or fire-performance certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps mate with?
faqs.a: A T-bolt clamp closes a hose onto a shank, nipple or barb sized to the same hose, tightened by its T-bolt. See [the single bolt clamp](/p/single-bolt-clamp) for a bolted clamp in carbon steel or SS304.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Where are the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps used?
faqs.a: T-bolt clamps are used on heavy and large-diameter hose where a wide band spreads the clamping force, such as on truck and equipment hose and on pipe connections. Tell us the hose and the fitting and we confirm the right clamp.

faqs.q: How do the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps differ from Single Bolt Clamp?
faqs.a: The T-bolt clamps are sized by diameter range and carry 15 models with HC part numbers, while [Single Bolt Clamp](/p/single-bolt-clamp) is a bolted clamp with 33 ranges in carbon steel or SS304. Choose by the hose outside diameter and the duty.

faqs.q: Where are the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps shipped from, and what origin and HS code apply?
faqs.a: We ship the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Are the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps available from stock in Dubai for export?
faqs.a: Yes. We stock the Buyers Products T-bolt hose clamps at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and send it worldwide with the best lead times. Tell us the models and quantities on [our contact page](/contact) and we will quote.

faqs.q: Where and how is the flat steel spiral hose guard used?
faqs.a: The flat steel spiral hose guard is a steel strip wound flat into an open spiral that wraps round a hose to stop it chafing, kinking at the end fitting, or being cut on sharp edges. It is sold by the foot in two sizes. This listing carries 2 part numbers, covering 0.84" ID and 1.22" ID.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: The listing carries 2 part numbers, IH-HP-AHG84 for 0.84" ID and IH-HP-AHG122 for 1.22" ID, each sold per foot. Choose the inside diameter just above the hose outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: Measure the hose outside diameter and pick the next inside diameter up: 0.84" ID or 1.22" ID. A guard that is too tight will not slide on; one too large will not protect against kinking at the fitting.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the flat steel spiral hose guard, because it protects a hose rather than holding pressure. It does not change the hose's working pressure; the hose or bundle keeps its own rating.

faqs.q: What is the flat steel spiral hose guard made from?
faqs.a: The guard is steel strip wound flat, as listed. Steel resists cutting and abrasion better than plastic; it can rust in wet service, so tell us if the hose works in salt or washdown areas.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, SAE or EN standard for the flat steel spiral hose guard and holds no certificates. If your project needs a material or fire-performance certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts does the flat steel spiral hose guard mate with?
faqs.a: The guard fits over the hose and runs up to the end fitting to stop it kinking where the hose leaves the fitting. For a softer cover see [the nylon sleeve hose guard](/p/nylon-sleeve-hose-guard) or [the plastic spiral hose wrap](/p/plastic-spiral-hose-wrap).

faqs.q: How should the flat steel spiral hose guard be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the flat steel spiral hose guard. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: A steel spiral guard is fitted to hose that runs over sharp edges, through moving machinery or in places where it could be cut or kinked, on mobile equipment, presses and tool hoses.

faqs.q: How does the flat steel spiral hose guard differ from the steel spring hose guard for jack hose?
faqs.a: The flat steel guard is an open spiral of steel strip in 2 sizes, 0.84" ID and 1.22" ID, sold by the foot, while [the steel spring hose guard for jack hose](/p/steel-spring-hose-guard-for-jack-hose) is round-wire steel spring sized for 1/4" and 3/8" jack hose. Pick the spring for small jack hose and the flat strip for larger hose.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: We ship the flat steel spiral hose guard from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Is the flat steel spiral hose guard available from stock in Dubai for export?
faqs.a: Yes, we hold the flat steel spiral hose guard in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Request pricing for your part numbers through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the nylon sleeve hose guard used for?
faqs.a: The nylon sleeve hose guard is a woven nylon sleeve pulled over a hose or a group of hoses to protect them from abrasion, UV and weather, and to bundle them. It is flexible, follows bends and elbows, and is sold by the foot. This listing carries 19 part numbers, covering 0.71" ID to 3.66" ID.

faqs.q: Which sizes is the nylon sleeve hose guard available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 19 part numbers from 0.71" ID to 3.66" ID, such as IH-HP-NHS-071, IH-HP-NHS-100 and IH-HP-NHS-207, each sold per foot. Choose the inside diameter just above the hose or bundle outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the nylon sleeve hose guard?
faqs.a: Measure the outside diameter of the hose or bundle and pick the next inside diameter up from the 19 sizes. A sleeve that is too large will not hold a bundle tight; one too small cannot be pulled over the hose.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the nylon sleeve hose guard have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the nylon sleeve hose guard, because it protects a hose rather than holding pressure. It does not change the hose's working pressure; the hose or bundle keeps its own rating.

faqs.q: Which materials is the nylon sleeve hose guard offered in?
faqs.a: The sleeve is woven nylon, as listed. Nylon resists abrasion and UV, but it is a textile and does not stop a cut from a sharp edge, so use a steel guard where cutting is the risk.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the nylon sleeve hose guard?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, SAE or EN standard for the nylon sleeve hose guard and holds no certificates. If your project needs a material or fire-performance certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: What does the nylon sleeve hose guard connect to?
faqs.a: The sleeve goes over a hose or a group of hoses and follows bends and elbows. For a split or wrap-on style see [the plastic spiral hose wrap](/p/plastic-spiral-hose-wrap); for cut protection see [the flat steel spiral guard](/p/flat-steel-spiral-hose-guard).

faqs.q: How should the nylon sleeve hose guard be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the nylon sleeve hose guard. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Where is the nylon sleeve hose guard used?
faqs.a: Nylon sleeves protect hoses from abrasion, UV and weather and bundle them tidy on mobile equipment, cranes, presses and hydraulic tools, where hoses rub on frames and each other.

faqs.q: How does the nylon sleeve hose guard differ from the plastic spiral hose wrap?
faqs.a: The nylon sleeve is pulled over the hose, so the end fittings must be free or the line disconnected, in 19 sizes from 0.71" ID to 3.66" ID, while [the plastic spiral hose wrap](/p/plastic-spiral-hose-wrap) winds on without disconnecting the hose in 6 sizes. Use the wrap on a hose already fitted.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the nylon sleeve hose guard?
faqs.a: We ship the nylon sleeve hose guard from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Do you keep the nylon sleeve hose guard in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We stock the nylon sleeve hose guard at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and send it worldwide with the best lead times. Tell us the models and quantities on [our contact page](/contact) and we will quote.

faqs.q: Where and how is the plastic spiral hose wrap used?
faqs.a: The plastic spiral hose wrap winds onto one hose or a bundle of hoses and cables without disconnecting them, guarding them against abrasion and keeping them together. It resists oils, solvents and fuel, and PHWE-20 is a heavier HDPE version. This listing carries 6 part numbers, covering 1/2" ID to 1-1/2" ID.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the plastic spiral hose wrap?
faqs.a: The listing carries 6 part numbers from 1/2" ID to 1-1/2" ID, including IH-HP-PHW08, IH-HP-PHW16 and the heavy-duty IH-HP-PHWE-20 in HDPE. They are sold as 100 ft rolls, 50 ft rolls or per foot, so check the supply form of the part number you order.

faqs.q: How should I select the plastic spiral hose wrap for my application?
faqs.a: Measure the outside diameter of the hose or bundle and pick the next inside diameter up. Choose the heavy-duty HDPE wrap, PHWE-20, where the hose rubs hard; for 1/2" to 1-1/2" the standard wraps are sold in rolls.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the plastic spiral hose wrap have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the plastic spiral hose wrap, because it protects a hose rather than holding pressure. It does not change the hose's working pressure; the hose or bundle keeps its own rating.

faqs.q: Which materials is the plastic spiral hose wrap offered in?
faqs.a: The wrap is plastic, which the listing says resists oils, solvents and fuel, and PHWE-20 is a heavier HDPE wrap. Plastic wraps protect against abrasion rather than cuts.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the plastic spiral hose wrap?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, SAE or EN standard for the plastic spiral hose wrap and holds no certificates. If your project needs a material or fire-performance certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: What does the plastic spiral hose wrap connect to?
faqs.a: The wrap winds on over a hose, a bundle of hoses or cables without disconnecting the line. See [the nylon sleeve hose guard](/p/nylon-sleeve-hose-guard) for a pull-on textile sleeve and [the split corrugated sleeve](/p/split-corrugated-polypropylene-hose-sleeve).

faqs.q: How should the plastic spiral hose wrap be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the plastic spiral hose wrap. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the plastic spiral hose wrap?
faqs.a: Spiral wrap is used to guard hoses and cables against abrasion and to keep them together on machinery, vehicles and tools, and to repair a worn spot without removing the hose.

faqs.q: How does the plastic spiral hose wrap differ from the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve?
faqs.a: The plastic spiral wrap winds on in 6 sizes from 1/2" to 1-1/2" ID and resists oils, solvents and fuel, while [the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve](/p/split-corrugated-polypropylene-hose-sleeve) is a split black corrugated sleeve in metric sizes with a stated temperature range. Both go on without disconnecting the hose.

faqs.a: We ship the plastic spiral hose wrap from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where and how is the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve used?
faqs.a: The split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve is a black sleeve split along its length so it can be put on and taken off a hose or cable bundle without disconnecting it. The listing gives a temperature range of -40 °C to 135 °C. This listing carries 9 part numbers, covering 15.5 mm ID, 18.8 mm ID and 22.6 mm ID.

faqs.q: Which sizes is the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 9 part numbers in three sizes, 15.5 mm, 18.8 mm and 22.6 mm ID, each in three coil lengths such as IH-HP-COR-15.5-492. Choose the inside diameter just above the hose or bundle outside diameter, then the coil length.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve?
faqs.a: Measure the outside diameter of the hose or bundle and pick the next inside diameter up, then choose the coil length for the run: each size comes in three coils, from 20 ft to 164 ft. The flat-wave corrugation bends round corners and elbows.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve have?
faqs.a: The listing gives a temperature range of -40 °F to 275 °F (-40 °C to 135 °C) but no pressure rating, because the sleeve protects the hose and carries no pressure itself. The hose keeps its own pressure rating.

faqs.q: Which materials is the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve offered in?
faqs.a: The sleeve is black corrugated polypropylene. The listing states it meets DIN 5510 and BS 6853, the rail fire standards, which matters for rolling stock and tunnel installations.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve?
faqs.a: The listing states the polypropylene meets DIN 5510 and BS 6853, the rail fire standards. No certificate is held on the listing, so if your project needs a test report or declaration, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker.

faqs.q: What does the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve connect to?
faqs.a: The split sleeve goes over a hose or a bundle of hoses and cables without disconnecting them. See [the plastic spiral hose wrap](/p/plastic-spiral-hose-wrap) for a wrap in 6 sizes and [the nylon sleeve](/p/nylon-sleeve-hose-guard) for a pull-on style.

faqs.q: How should the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve?
faqs.a: Split corrugated sleeve is used to guard hose and cable runs on rolling stock, machinery and vehicles, where fire performance and flexibility round corners are needed. It can be fitted on a line already installed.

faqs.q: How does the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve differ from the plastic spiral hose wrap?
faqs.a: The split corrugated sleeve is polypropylene, sized in millimetres in 3 sizes with a stated -40 °C to 135 °C range and rail fire standards, while [the plastic spiral hose wrap](/p/plastic-spiral-hose-wrap) winds on in inch sizes and resists oils, solvents and fuel. Both go on without disconnecting the hose.

faqs.q: Can I buy the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve from stock in the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes, the split corrugated polypropylene hose sleeve is held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the steel spring hose guard for jack hose used for?
faqs.a: The steel spring hose guard is a round-wire spring that slides over 1/4" or 3/8" hydraulic jack hose to protect it from abrasion and kinking at the fittings. The size column is the hose bore. This listing carries 2 part numbers, covering 1/4" and 3/8".

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the steel spring hose guard for jack hose?
faqs.a: The listing carries 2 part numbers, IH-HP-HJKHG04-95 for 1/4" and IH-HP-HJKHG06-95 for 3/8" jack hose, where the size is the hose bore. The length is not published and is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: How should I select the steel spring hose guard for jack hose for my application?
faqs.a: Choose by the hose bore, 1/4" or 3/8", and tell us the length you need, because the length is confirmed with the quotation. The spring slides over the hose, so check that the end fittings clear it.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the steel spring hose guard for jack hose have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the steel spring hose guard for jack hose, because it protects a hose rather than holding pressure. It does not change the hose's working pressure; the hose or bundle keeps its own rating.

faqs.q: What is the steel spring hose guard for jack hose made from?
faqs.a: The guard is steel spring wire, as listed. It resists abrasion and stops the hose kinking at the fitting, and it is for jack hose rather than a general-purpose cover.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the steel spring hose guard for jack hose?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, SAE or EN standard for the steel spring hose guard for jack hose and holds no certificates. If your project needs a material or fire-performance certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts does the steel spring hose guard for jack hose mate with?
faqs.a: The spring slides over a 1/4" or 3/8" hydraulic jack hose and protects it at the end fittings. For larger hose see [the flat steel spiral hose guard](/p/flat-steel-spiral-hose-guard).

faqs.q: How should the steel spring hose guard for jack hose be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Measure the hose or bundle first and choose the next inside diameter up for the steel spring hose guard for jack hose. Fit it over the hose before the end fittings are crimped, or use a wrap or split style that goes on without disconnecting the line. Inspect it for wear and replace it when the hose shows through.

faqs.q: Where is the steel spring hose guard for jack hose used?
faqs.a: Spring guards protect jack and tool hose from abrasion and kinking at the end fittings, where hoses are dragged across workshop floors, base plates and structures.

faqs.q: How does the steel spring hose guard for jack hose differ from the flat steel spiral hose guard?
faqs.a: The spring guard fits 1/4" and 3/8" jack hose by bore with no length published, while [the flat steel spiral hose guard](/p/flat-steel-spiral-hose-guard) is a flat steel strip in 0.84" and 1.22" ID sold by the foot. Choose the spring for small jack hose.
